description: Finds source files that are not reachable from any test file through the import graph — i.e. completely untested code. Use to answer: which parts of the codebase have zero test coverage?

project_root.description: Absolute path to the TypeScript project root (must contain tsconfig.json)

source_dirs.description: Restrict results to these directories (absolute or relative to project_root). Defaults to the entire project.

name: get_coverage_gaps
